description: I’m a CS student who builds full-stack projects (C++, React, backend APIs) and enjoys algorithms, graph problems and machine learning, and I like turning complex data into decision-making tools that people can use. Join us if you want to build a polished, well-explained NASA project, and we’re looking for teammates with strengths in geospatial or remote-sensing data, 3D or UI design, or science storytelling and pitching.
